title: DojoLiq Strawberry Banana Smoothie 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Strawberry Banana Smoothie 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid delivers a thick, creamy, and exceptionally smooth fruit profile. Experience the soft, jammy sweetness of ripe Strawberry on the inhale, which is then seamlessly complemented by the mellow, rich notes of soft Banana on the exhale, for a complex yet superbly balanced and distinctively creamy finish. Formulated with a bespoke VG/PG ratio finely tuned specifically to this flavour, this premium nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted to provide precise clarity and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it ensures rapid nicotine satisfaction. This tailored blend performs reliably with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and classic starter devices, ensuring sharp and accurate flavour transmission. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. Offering more than 30 expertly crafted options, this range provides a highly cost-effective and dependable option for every palate. Beyond the creamy fruit notes of Strawberry Banana Smoothie, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the sharp Blackberry Lime or the nostalgic Classic Chew.
